# Best MagSafe car mounts (as of Oct 2026)

**Best for most iPhone owners: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- Includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, rotates between portrait and landscape, and fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Vent fit is the catch. Belkin specifies slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones can droop.
- Reviewed by [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/) and [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/). Both pages have Amazon buy buttons, but I don't have a direct product link.

**Best for fast charging and reliability: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (MagGo AirCool, A2933), $89.99 list**
- It has active cooling (thermoelectric plus a fan). The [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) reviewers use it daily and call it their best overall.
- The [Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) lists it at a discounted $69.99 and says a 60W adapter is included. RottenWiFi says 25W needs a 45W+ adapter.
- It tops out at 25W only on newer iPhones (17, 16 Pro Max, 16 Plus). Older iPhones get about 15W.
- It isn't compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles, or cars with nonstandard vents.

**Best value with cooling: ESR HaloLock Qi2 15W with CryoBoost**
- It has a fan to limit overheating, is Qi2-certified, and mounts on a vent or dash.
- You can [buy it at ESR's official US store](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) for $39.99. Code PARTNER18 takes off $7.19, bringing it to about $32.80, and expires 12/31/2026. This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you.
- Prices vary by source. The Gadgeteer listed it at $18.99 and noted that an 18W adapter isn't included. Dealectric says it's unclear whether an adapter is included, so confirm before buying.

**Budget picks:** The LISEN 15W vent/dash mount ($15.99–$26.79) and the ESR 15W mount ($19.99) appear on the Amazon buy links in the [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/) roundup. I couldn't verify these cheaper mounts independently.

## Before you buy
- **Check for Qi2.** A "MagSafe-compatible" listing without Qi2 certification may charge at only 7.5W.
- **Ignore suction and magnet-force numbers** like "80LB" or "3800gf." MountGuys notes they often describe the suction base, not the phone hold.
- **Match the mount to your vents.** If they're shallow, vertical, or flimsy, choose a dash or windshield mount instead, such as Belkin's vent/dash version ($47.99).
- **Use a strong adapter.** You need roughly 30W+ for 25W charging, and the mount may not include one.

If you tell me your phone model and car, I can narrow this to one pick.
